semantics: The three callbacks write ROM addresses 0x0000693E, 0x00006952, and 0x0000695A to CAMERA_SCROLL_DATA_CURSOR at 0x00FF7E1A. The level camera callback consumes signed words from that cursor, while the 16-word table at 0x0000693E provides the selected compact scroll-delta sequences.
boundary_basis: Each callback is a complete 12-byte absolute-pointer setter ending in RTS.
The callbacks are separated by their own RTS instructions and the random-parity callback begins immediately at 0x001B52FA.
The 32-byte table ends at 0x0000695D; two zero alignment bytes at 0x0000695E-0x0000695F precede SCENE_RESOURCE_RANDOM_ACTOR_VARIANTS at 0x00006960.
evidence: AnimationVM callback pointers embedded in the player and collision streams
conclusion: The former 0x001B52D6-0x001B52F9 UNKNOWN range is a three-entry AnimationVM camera-scroll selector family, and the formerly untyped 0x0000693E-0x0000695D data is a compact signed delta table. Both are now canonical.
